summary: Expanded discovery covers 68 creative fields, 545 repository queries and 18 model tasks, with live web research across all fields and eight configured source ecosystems. New adaptive fields cover neural clothing and visual dubbing. Detailed guides span neural audio codecs, garment simulation, editable film/video production, accessible media, neural worlds, CAD, design and publication. Earlier screened entries receive complete guides where supported; first library coverage is not a claim that an application launched today. Canonical repository aliases and unchanged screened entries are not counted again. Complete software grants were reviewed, including additional notices and modified-license exclusions; model weights, assets, host dependencies and paid services remain separate. No discovered app was installed or run. Quality remains unverified except for current cited instability or unfinished workflows. Missing source/license evidence, access failures and bounded discovery remain visible. The first scheduled whole-library weekly review starts October 26 and is not due today. All 545 repository queries and 18 model-task searches completed without failed or partial queries. The 114 bounded repository queries do not establish exhaustive coverage. Source collection also recorded unavailable watchlist repositories and one repository-history failure; Codeberg and SourceHut remain web-access gaps. Raw repositories and model leads still require individual eligibility and quality review.
